audience: membership and event teams whose Glue Up organization has API access enabled

useCases.title: Review upcoming events
useCases.text: List upcoming events in a chosen date range and check their publication flags and venues.

useCases.title: Find a member’s contact details
useCases.text: Search the membership directory and inspect a member’s contact information and custom properties.

useCases.title: Inspect company memberships
useCases.text: Filter company memberships by industry or name, then inspect a membership and its members.

useCases.title: Review overdue invoices
useCases.text: List finance invoices with overdue balances and inspect their amounts, dates and purchaser details.
